verdict: Worth a try, no token purchase needed
review: A big-budget battle royale shooter, free on Steam, with the full 1.0 release in Oct 2026. More than 437,000 wallets on the GUNZ chain.
pro: A genuinely good game you can try without spending money
con: The GUN token is down 97.2% from its peak and hit a new low in Sep 2026

review: One of the few Web3 games with real revenue: $9.9M in H1 2026 from 564,714 paying wallets.
pro: A famous Nexon game brand with real revenue
con: The token is still volatile, and the game has had cheating problems

review: A cozy farming RPG that entered Steam Early Access on 12 Oct 2026 at $14.99 (10% off until 26 Oct).
pro: A paid Steam game; no token needed to play
con: No clear information yet on a token or in-game economy

review: An anime-style PvP game that entered Early Access on 22 Oct 2026, with a confirmed PS5 deal for the full release.
pro: A console deal is a good sign
con: Sources do not give token or chain details; check the contract yourself before buying

verdict: Play for fun with money you can lose
review: Hood Siege, Stonewatch, Play Kindra, Farm Valley and Computers RH are small browser games with a few thousand players each.
pro: Most are free to start; some burn tokens from fees
con: Low liquidity, and Computers RH is made by a single developer

review: Overworld is announced for Dec 2026; a good-looking game on Ethereum/Immutable.

con: ILV is down 99.8%, and the team reportedly cut salaries to stretch its funding
